questions.prompt: While step 2 runs, you send a steer. When does the model first see it?
options: Inside the request that step 2 already sent
In the request of the next step of the same turn
Only in the first step of the next turn
Never, because a running turn rejects new input
questions.explanation: A sent request cannot change, so the steer waits in the next-step list. The next step of the same turn claims it.

questions.prompt: The model ends step 3 in text, but the next-step list holds one message. What does the loop do?
options: It ends the turn and drops the message
It ends the turn and starts a new turn with the message
It keeps the turn open and runs another step that claims the message
It cancels the turn and reports an error
questions.explanation: A turn the model would end stays open while the next-step list is not empty, so one more step runs with that message.

questions.prompt: How does inject differ from steer?
options: Inject puts the message in the next-turn list
Inject writes the message to the record and steer does not
Inject does not wake an idle loop; the message waits for the next step that runs
Inject replaces every message already waiting
questions.explanation: Both add to the next-step list. Steer also wakes the loop, while inject waits for a step that runs for another reason.
